src.signText: function signText(r) { return pfFit(r.theme.shared ? r.theme.name : r.name, 18); }
src.pfFit: function pfFit(s, max) { s = String(s || '').toUpperCase().replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim(); return [...s].length > max ? [...s].slice(0, max - 1).join('') + '…' : s; }

label.note: r.label (a DOM div) is hidden by the page CSS ("rooms carry painted signs instead"); the sign is canvas art. If a DOM label is ever shown: font -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,sans-serif 12px/1.3 weight 600, colour rgba(255,255,255,.9), background rgba(20,16,32,.55), padding 3px 9px, radius 999px.

rules.clouds: cloud i is at x = round(((i*131*S + t*(.004+(i%3)*.002)*S) % (W+80*S)) - 60*S) + round(px*.8), y as recorded (cloud sprite i of the bucket: w, y); drawn with the sprite at (x+dx, y+dy); t in ms
rules.gradient: vertical gradient SKY[0] -> SKY[1] over the screen height, then the sunrise glow bands of drawSky
rules.sun: celestial layer is cut at its screen position for the screen size above; sun anchor in .sun

poses.anchors: sprite drawn at (X - ax, Y - ay) where (X, Y) is the point drawClawd was given (the feet, iso of the spot)

timing.waiting: sample i of 6 over 1634 ms: sin(t/260)
timing.cat: walk floor(t/120)%2; sit2 when floor(t/700+seed*7)%6==0; nap Zs (t/1800+seed)%1
timing.dog: walk floor(t/120)%2 (90 when fast); sit2 when floor(t/900+seed*7)%6==0 (wag: floor(t/140)%2==0); bark: sit1/bark floor(t/260)%2 and the text on when floor(t/520)%2==0

proofNote: diff = pixels whose largest channel difference is > 24 against the page's own frame at t=100000 (no agents, no residents, clear weather, nothing animated differs: both frames are drawn at the same t); house = pixels the house changed against the sky-only frame

rules.bridge: Bridges are exported as concrete configurations (result.links, plan prefix of 13 links, valid for 0..14 projects). Rules for a renderer that wants to repeat them: planks n = Math.max(3, Math.round((s1 - s0) / .3)), plank colour ["#c48c58","#b88250","#cc965e"][(i*2 + (i>>2)) % 3], seam line at each plank i>0 in #7a4a2a, nail on odd i; posts m = Math.max(1, Math.round((s1 - s0 - .3) / 1.0)) at s0+.15+(s1-s0-.3)*i/m, rope 6 segments per span with sag 6.6 - sin(u*PI)*1.6; lanterns at s0+.15 and s1-.15 (lit when DARK > .3, glow 20*S #ffc870). Source: room/index.html drawLink.
rules.stair: Stairs are concrete (13 steps, W=.5, rope posts every 3rd step, lantern at the foot); the swing (L.lift) is only exported down/up. Source: room/index.html drawStair.
rules.lift: The lift is exported per floor count (3 for 0 projects, 4 for >=1): shaft slices plus cage; pulleys are static. Source: room/index.html drawLifts.
rules.crossFade: Draw bucket A layer k, then bucket B layer k at alpha u, pairing by index. Layer counts differ by one between some buckets (night vs day art), so the pairing is not valid there; see limits.

limits: dynamic items frozen at t=100000, clock and window panes at the bucket hour
stair swing only down/up, pulleys static
sky cut for a 2304x1490 canvas; other canvas sizes need the page sky
cross-fade at a non-bucket hour (19.25 in the proof) does NOT reproduce the page: lit()/DARK-conditional art is not a linear blend of two buckets; measured exactly at bucket hours only

note.sprites: [page, x, y, w, h] in the page PNG; ids index this array
